description: The implied volatility surface from Cboe's delayed option data: at-the-money IV by expiration (term structure), 25-delta put and call IV with the risk reversal and butterfly (skew), and IV at fixed moneyness from 80 to 120 percent of the price (smile).

expirations.description: How many expirations from the nearest; default 8.

symbol.description: A stock or ETF (AAPL, SPY) or an index (SPX, NDX, RUT, VIX).

name: volatility_surface

outputSchema.description: term_structure has one row per expiration; smile has IV at fixed moneyness per expiration (fractions a year).

title: Volatility surface (Cboe)
